title: request for shipping services - u.s. embassy in equatorial guinea
paragraphs: dear prospective offeror/quoter: the u.s. embassy malabo has a requirement for shipping services ( air freight and transportation services). you are invited to submit a quotation including all documents specified in this request. you are encouraged to make your quotations competitive. you are also cautioned against any collusion with other potential offerors regarding price quotations to be submitted. the rfq does not commit the u.s. embassy malabo to make any award . the embassy may cancel this rfq or any part of it at any time. your offer must include the following to be considered complete: completed pricing table (please note that the rate provided will be a fixed price for the duration of this service) complete business registration documents including current domestic tax certificate. work plan (how shipment will be handled, communication between the embassy and company, delivery process and documentation etc.) shipping licensed certificate to operate in equatorial guinea emergency plans for holidays signed copies of the ndaa form and the anti-illegal discrimination certification validity of offer the transportation officer intends to hold a conference relating to this request on january 06, 2026, at 10:00 am (local time) at the us embassy malabo. should you want to attend, please forward your name, designation, and identification details to malaboshipping@state.gov on or before january 2nd, 2026 . the transportation officer advises you carefully go through this document, and if you are interested in submitting an offer, please do so by completing the aforementioned documents and the required information and send to malaboshipping@state.gov by january 09, 2026. at 5:00pm (local time) . oral quotations will not be accepted. questions related to this request shall be forwarded to malaboshipping@state.gov on or before january 07, 2026. find related documents: transportation tender-american embassy malabo ndaa form rfq –
